label: Exact
definition: The witness names the referent in the reference form for its period.

label: Variant
definition: The witness names the referent in a recognisably same form differing by spelling, script or inflection.

label: Alternative
definition: The witness names the referent with a materially different name rather than a variant of the reference form.

label: Textual only
definition: The referent is named in the source's text or index but does not appear on its map surface.

label: Mapped unlabelled
definition: The referent is drawn on the map surface but carries no name there.

label: Extra muros
definition: The referent lies outside the source's declared coverage, so its silence carries no evidential weight.

label: Source silent
definition: The referent lies inside coverage at a scale that would have shown it, and the source still does not name it.

label: Not applicable
definition: The referent did not yet exist, or had ceased to exist, at the source's date.

label: Survival unknown
definition: The witness is lost, unlocated or inaccessible, so the question cannot yet be put to it.

label: Reconstructed
definition: The reading is an editorial restoration rather than something read off a witness.

label: Direct
definition: Read from the witness itself by the editor, with a locator.

label: High
definition: Reported by a scholarly edition or catalogue that cites the witness.

label: Medium
definition: Supported, but through a chain the editor has not closed to the witness.

label: Low
definition: Plausible and recorded, but the identification or the reading is contested.

label: Editorial reconstruction
definition: Asserted by this project rather than by any source; must never be shown as a source reading.

label: Source geometry
definition: Coordinates or a line taken from the source's own graticule or survey.

label: Georeferenced source
definition: Modern coordinates derived by georeferencing the source image; carries a stated error.

label: Scholarly reconstruction
definition: Location established by published scholarship rather than by the source.

label: Editorial reconstruction
definition: Location asserted by this project; the weakest class that may still be published.

label: Display generalisation
definition: Geometry simplified or nudged for legibility; never a positional claim.

label: Exact year
definition: A single year attested by the source or its colophon.

label: Year range
definition: A bounded interval both of whose ends are attested.

label: Circa
definition: A conventional approximate date carried by the scholarship.

label: Century
definition: Resolvable only to a century or part of one.

label: Terminus post quem
definition: Not earlier than a known date; the upper bound is open.

label: Terminus ante quem
definition: Not later than a known date; the lower bound is open.

label: Disputed
definition: Competing dates are defended in the literature; requires a recorded editorial decision.

label: Undated
definition: No date can responsibly be assigned.

label: Raw
definition: As captured. Machine output and unchecked transcription both land here.

label: Normalized
definition: Fields regularised against the vocabularies. Still unreviewed by a human.

label: Reviewed
definition: A named human has checked the record against its locator.

label: Approved
definition: Cleared for publication: evidence, rights and vocabulary all hold.

label: Published
definition: Released under a corpus version and cited by at least one trench.

label: Manual
definition: Transcribed and normalised by a human editor.

label: Rule based
definition: Produced by a deterministic script whose rules are in the repository.

label: Imported
definition: Taken from an external authority file without re-transcription.

label: LLM assisted
definition: Drafted with model assistance; cannot pass normalized without a named reviewer.

label: Public domain
definition: Out of copyright in the country of origin.

label: CC0
definition: Dedicated to the public domain by the holder.

label: CC BY
definition: Reusable with attribution.

label: CC BY-SA
definition: Reusable with attribution under the same licence.

label: CC BY-NC
definition: Non-commercial only; does not clear the publication bar.

label: CC BY-ND
definition: No derivatives; does not clear the publication bar.

label: In copyright
definition: Protected and not licensed to this project.

label: Rights unknown
definition: Not yet established; never a publication clearance.

label: Settlement
definition: An inhabited place of any size.

label: Fortification
definition: A fort, castrum or citadel treated as its own referent.

label: Crossing
definition: A bridge, ford or ferry point on a river.

label: Archaeological site
definition: A site known chiefly through excavation.

label: Region
definition: A named territory rather than a point.

label: Waterway
definition: A river or watercourse used as a reference feature.

label: Transylvania
definition: The intra-Carpathian plateau.

label: Banat
definition: The south-west, between Mureș, Tisa and Danube.

label: Crișana
definition: The north-west, on the Criș rivers.

label: Maramureș
definition: The far north.

label: Oltenia
definition: Wallachia west of the Olt.

label: Muntenia
definition: Wallachia east of the Olt.

label: Moldavia
definition: Between the Carpathians and the Prut.

label: Dobrogea
definition: Between the lower Danube and the Black Sea.

label: Bucovina
definition: The north-west of historic Moldavia.

label: Page
definition: A printed page number.

label: Folio
definition: A manuscript folio with recto or verso.

label: Sheet
definition: A numbered sheet or segment of a multi-sheet map.

label: Section
definition: A named book, chapter or table section.

label: None
definition: No locator recorded; never sufficient for review.

label: Latin
definition: Latin script.

label: Greek
definition: Greek script.

label: Cyrillic
definition: Cyrillic script.

label: Latin
definition: Latin.

label: Ancient Greek
definition: Ancient Greek.

label: Romanian
definition: Romanian.

label: German
definition: German.

label: Hungarian
definition: Hungarian.

label: Slavic
definition: Slavic, where the source does not resolve further.

label: Russian
definition: Russian.

label: Dacian
definition: Dacian, as transmitted through another language's script.

label: Undetermined
definition: Language not asserted for an authority-file display label.

label: Ptolemaic
definition: Present in the coordinate catalogue tradition.

label: Itinerary
definition: Present in road-books and station lists.

label: Roman epigraphic
definition: Attested by inscriptions or military diplomas.

label: Medieval textual
definition: Attested by charters, chronicles or registers rather than maps.

label: Portolan
definition: Present in the coastal chart tradition.

label: Early modern print
definition: Present in printed maps before the systematic surveys.

label: Habsburg survey
definition: Covered by the systematic military surveys.

label: Modern survey
definition: Covered by geodetic and contemporary survey.

label: Roman centre
definition: A colonia, municipium or provincial administrative seat.

label: Frontier site
definition: A limes fort or frontier installation.

label: Danube crossing
definition: A bridge, ford or ferry point on the Danube.

label: Transylvanian
definition: Inside the Carpathian ring.

label: Wallachian
definition: In Oltenia or Muntenia.

label: Moldavian
definition: In historic Moldavia.

label: Black Sea
definition: On or near the Black Sea littoral.

label: Medieval textual
definition: Carries strong medieval textual evidence.

label: Name variation
definition: Carries significant variation of name across languages or periods.

label: Unlocated
definition: The site itself is unsettled in the literature.

label: Modern reference
definition: The living settlement's own coordinates, used as a reference point rather than as a historical claim.

label: Located
definition: A reference location can responsibly be given.

label: Unlocated
definition: The site is unsettled in the literature; the record carries no coordinates rather than a guess.

label: Coordinate catalogue
definition: Places fixed as numbers rather than drawn.

label: Itinerary
definition: Road-books and station lists; topology rather than geometry.

label: Mappa mundi
definition: The world arranged on a theological or encyclopaedic schema.

label: Portolan
definition: Coastal charts drawn from sailing practice.

label: Regional print
definition: Printed maps of one country or province by a local or commissioned hand.

label: Antiquarian reconstruction
definition: Early-modern restorations of ancient geography over contemporary outlines.

label: Military survey
definition: Systematic state survey executed by army parties.

label: National survey
definition: Civil survey published under a national authority.

label: Digital survey
definition: Continuous contemporary feeds with no single edition.

label: Administrative register
definition: An official list of offices, units or holdings compiled for administration rather than for depiction.

label: Numismatic
definition: Coinage: the legend and type struck by a mint, catalogued as a series.

label: Scholarly edition
definition: A modern critical edition or catalogue of a body of sources, cited as the reader's access to them.

label: Narrative history
definition: An account of events written as a text rather than drawn, cited by the divisions the work itself carries.

label: Modern study
definition: A modern work of scholarship arguing a case about its sources, cited as an authority on them rather than as a witness to them.

label: Legal instrument
definition: An act, decree or ordinance issued by a state, whose text is itself the administrative event rather than a report of one.

label: Whole work
definition: The witness has no finer subdivision; the work itself is the maximum precision available.

label: From witness
definition: Read off the witness or its facsimile by the editor.

label: From edition
definition: Taken from a named scholarly edition of the witness.

label: From secondary
definition: Taken from scholarship reporting the witness at second hand.

label: From local display
definition: Taken from this project's own earlier presentation; never sufficient for review.

label: Translatio
definition: The name is carried to a different referent.

label: Restitutio
definition: The name is restored to a referent it had formerly held.

label: Inventio
definition: The name is coined for a referent that never carried it.

label: Applicatio
definition: The name is applied to a new administrative or institutional entity.

label: Settlement
definition: A single inhabited place.

label: Region
definition: A named territory.

label: Polity
definition: A state or province as an institution.

label: Ecclesiastical province
definition: A church administrative division.

label: Continuity
definition: The later use continues the earlier one; requires evidence beyond the shared string.

label: Derivation
definition: The later form derives from the earlier by transmission.

label: Revival
definition: The later use deliberately reaches back over a gap.

label: Homonym only
definition: The same string, and no relationship claimed. The anti-continuity edge.
